text:
alex: Quick sync: runtime retried streaming fallback on a corrupted safetensors shard and we thrashed warmup cache. Anyone seen this?
mina: saw it 03:10 UTC. fallback retried 4x, OOM during prefix rehydrate. Manifest listed 4MB chunk; blob ~4.2MB.
jon: size vs checksum mismatch? logs: 
2026-03-20T03:10:12Z loader: shard read failed: expected 4194304 bytes, got 4404019
2026-03-20T03:10:12Z runtime: fallback -> stream-merge selected

alex: proposal: add an advisory Warmup-Hint (runtime->loader) and a ManifestSanity check in loader that fails fast on size/checksum mismatch. If sanity fails, runtime should pick a different bundle, not keep retrying same shard.
mina: WarmupHint proto idea: {shard_id, priority(0|1|2), verify_mode: fast|full, prefetch_window_ms}. Don't bind to HTTP only; include IPC/sidecar.
jon: tradeoffs: fast verify = length+crc32 low latency but risk corruption; full = blake3 higher cost (~150ms/200MB on p4d) but safer. Need metrics: shard_verify_mode, verify_failures, stream_retries, warmup_latency.
sara: ops: rollback playbook?
mina: policy suggestion: full-verify fail -> mark bundle degraded, route to previous pinned version for 5m + alert. fast-verify fail -> single stream fallback; if also fails -> degrade. Degrade only after failures on >=3 hosts in 10m to reduce noise.
alex: question: should loader return mmap if only fast verify passed? Options: guarded mmap + runtime marks requests low-priority until full verify completes, or COW buffer (memory heavy). Start with guarded mmap + low-priority routing.
jon: also add small local verifier fence: if host is already verifying shard X, wait up to 200ms for result to avoid thundering herd.
sara: ops will write runbook appendix for pinning+alerts.
infra-bot: checklist: add integration test for corrupted chunk -> degraded marking -> runtime routes to fallback.
alex: I'll draft RFC (warmup wire schema, manifest flag, degrade policy, metrics). Jon/mina/sara please review.
